fields.note: Fed live by PledgePath and the hospice website. A refund, a chargeback or a late settlement changes the gift's row, or adds one, the moment it clears, at any hour and on close-out day too; nothing is sent round when it does. A close value or a claim line counts each gift as its row stands when that value or line is written: the latest row counts. Anything written earlier is brought into line before the close is finished.
fields.written_by: Callum Treharne, Data and Gift Aid Officer
